{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values per column:")
print(sales_df.isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicates
print(f"\nNumber of duplicate rows: {sales_df.duplicated().sum()}")

# Check unique values in status and converted columns
print(f"\nUnique values in 'status': {sales_df['status'].unique()}")
print(f"Unique values in 'converted': {sales_df['converted'].unique()}")

# Check if 'revenue' has negative values or unrealistic values
print(f"\nRevenue summary:\n{sales_df['revenue'].describe()}")"}
